ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT “Agreement”) is made as of the sixteenth day of August 2019 (the“Closing Date”),and effective as of July 1, 2016 (the “Effective_ Date") by and between the NEW.YORK QUARTERLY MEETING OF THE RELIGIOUS SOCIETY OF FRIENDS ("NYQM"), having an office at 15 Rutherford Place, New York, New York 10003, and FRIENDS SEMINARY ("FS"), having not otherwise defined shall have the meanings set forth inSection I of this Agreement. WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, NYQM is the owner of certain land (the“Block 897 Land"),and any improvements thereon (the “Block 897 Improvements"), in the City of New York, Borough of Manhattan, designated as Block 897, Lot 16 on the Tax Map of the City of New York for the hereto and made a part hereof (the Block 897 Land, together with the Block 897 Improvements,. arehereinafterreferred to as the“Block897Premises"); WHEREAS,byinstruments of even date and contemporaneouslywith execution of this Agreement, NYQM has (i) leased to FS pursuant to the Townhouses Ground Lease Agreement (hereinafter defined) that certain land and the improvements thereon of which it is owner identified as:(aa)Block 897,p/oLot 16 (f/k/aLot 29)on theTaxMap,andcommonly known as 212 East 16th Street; (bb) Block 897,p/o Lot 16 (f/k/a Lot 28) on the Tax Map, and commonly known as 214 East 16th Street; and (cc) Block 897,p/o Lot 16 on the Tax Map, and commonlyknown as 216 East 16th Street(the“FS Townhouses Ground LeaseParcel");and (ii) leased to FS pursuant to the 1964 Building Ground Lease Agreement that certain land of which it is owneridentified as Block 897,p/o Lot 16 on the Tax Map,and commonly known 222 East 16th Street (the“FS 1964 Building Ground Lease Parcel" and, together with the FS Townhouses Ground Lease Parcel, the “FS Land"), and together with the buildings and improvements thereon (the “FS Improvements"), as more particularly described in Exhibit A-2 (the FS Land, together with the FS Improvements, are referred to as the “FS Premises"); WHEREAS,the portions of the Block 897 Premises, commonly known as the“Oid School Building,” the “Central Building,”" the “Meetinghouse,” and the “Central Courtyard,” as more particularly described in Exhibit A-3 annexed hereto and made a part hereof (such portions of the Block 897 Land,the“NYQM Land”and such portions of the Block 897 Improvements thereon the“NYQM Improvements", together hereinafter referred to as the“NYQM Premises") have been retained by NYQM for its use, subject to the Old School Building Lease and Shared Spaces Agreement executed of even date and contemporaneously with execution of this Agreement;
